# Disagreement Log — Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 12

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Chapter:** SHE 012 — Vision 3, Chapter 4
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

### 1. V. 2 — "seed" vs. "offspring" vs. "children"
- **EMET:** "your seed" — literal Greek sperma
- **LOGOS:** "your offspring"
- **PNEUMA:** "your children"
- **Decision:** "your offspring" — "seed" is overly archaic; "offspring" bridges literal and accessible

### 2. V. 3 — "riotous living and wanton wickedness" vs. "wild living, reckless wickedness"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "riotous living and wanton wickedness"
- **PNEUMA:** "wild living, reckless wickedness"
- **Decision:** SOPHIA retains "riotous living and wanton wickedness" — these are technical moral categories in Shepherd

### 3. V. 4 — "correct the sins" vs. "restore the sins" vs. "heal every sin"
- **EMET:** "correct the sins of your house"
- **LOGOS:** "restore the sins of your household"
- **PNEUMA:** "heal every sin of your past"
- **Decision:** "heal the sins of your household" — iaomai = heal; this is the Shepherd's preferred metaphor

### 4. V. 5 — "goldsmith refines his work" — all three agree on core image
- Minor phrasing variations; unanimous on substance

### 5. V. 5 — "disheartened" vs. "dismayed" vs. "give up"
- **EMET:** "Do not be dismayed"
- **LOGOS:** "Do not lose heart"
- **PNEUMA:** "Don't give up"
- **Decision:** "Do not be disheartened" — captures the Greek me athumeseis precisely

**Total disagreements: 4**
